gl:definition.gl:content: a concept or technology which enables sharing of product related information that is essential for product sustainability and circularity, including those specified in regulations, across all relevant economic actors

gl:notes.gl:content: Example characteristics include environmental sustainability, environmental impact, and recyclability.

Definitional conflict: the EN 182xx series (18216, 18221, 18222, 18223, 18239, 18246) define DPP as a "digital record of product characteristics throughout its life cycle" — differing in noun (concept/technology vs record) and in stated scope (across relevant economic actors vs throughout the life cycle).

Definitional variant: EN 18219:2026 (§3.1.3) and EN 18220:2026 (§3.6) extend the EN-family definition with "accessible via electronic means through a data carrier" — a functional statement of the carrier subset of the ISO concept.
